mapper.select: SELECT FB.BLOCK_ID AS blockId, FB.CUSTOMER_NO AS customerNo, U.USER_NAME AS customerName, FB.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM FIXER_BLOCK FB JOIN USERS U ON FB.CUSTOMER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE FB.FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo} ORDER BY FB.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FIXER_BLOCK WHERE FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo} AND BLOCK_ID = #{blockId}
